### System Instructions
Be empathetic and concise.

### Developer Instructions
Always mention the 5-business-day refund window.

Context:

## Objective
Help the customer understand their refund options.

## Facts
- The customer's order #987 was delivered on 2026-08-10.

## Resources
- <untrusted-content source="retrieved-document" id="urn:ulcs:res:1">
Refunds are issued within 5 business days of an approved return.
</untrusted-content>

## Tool Results
- <untrusted-content source="unknown" id="urn:ulcs:toolresult:1">
{"orderId":"987","eligibleForRefund":true}
</untrusted-content>

## User Instructions
Please answer in a short paragraph, not a list.
I can help with that — may I ask the reason for the return?

notes: developer- and application-authority instructions were folded into the single Gemini systemInstruction, each under its own heading.
Tool results were rendered as a labeled text block, not native functionResponse parts.
Item-level metadata (priority, trust, sensitivity) is not representable in plain turn text; it only shaped which items were included and in what order.
